programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行 吃喝玩樂全攻略
programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 全民星攻略
programme.desc: 由館長曾國城擔任知識把關者，考驗著每個來挑戰九宮格益智遊戲的藝人明星想要攻略九宮格關卡，透過創意聯想邏輯推理理性分析，才有機會獲取智慧星幣，帶走夢幻大獎

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 柳舟記
programme.desc: 淮陽王崔行舟（張晚意 飾）年少有為，一生以剿滅仰山匪徒為己任柳眠棠（王楚然 飾）為仰山女寨主，帶領仰山眾人懲惡揚善某日，行舟救下受重傷失憶的眠棠，豈料她醒來後竟將行舟誤認為夫君崔九，行舟則誤以為眠棠是仰山頭領的寵妾，便將計就計假扮她的夫君探消息，想誘敵現身眠棠跟隨行舟守護邊關，兩人從客氣相處，進一步發展成兩情相悅，無奈身份被識破，感情又將面臨考驗?

programme.title: 主君的太陽
programme.desc: 個性樂觀如太陽的女子太恭實（孔曉振 飾），因發生事故後，成為可以看見鬼魂的人，她每天被鬼魂騷擾並生活在驚恐之中，使得她生活日夜顛倒精神不濟某日，恭實遇到個性高傲的購物中心社長朱中元（蘇志燮 飾），她不小心碰觸到中元的身體，沒想到這些騷擾她的鬼神竟立刻煙消雲散！那次之後，恭實決定巴著中元不放，並且把他當成自己的防空洞，兩人之間的不解之緣及愛情故事就此展開?

programme.title: 背著善宰跑
programme.desc: 柳善宰（邊佑錫 飾），Eclipse樂團主唱，外貌實力兼具的韓國頂流明星，看似風光的人生卻承受著許多壓力在他19歲的時候，其實最愛的是游泳，而且還有一位暗戀的女孩任率（金惠奫 飾），15年前因為一場意外終生不良於行，喪失求生意志的她，因為善宰的歌曲有了堅持下去的勇氣，決定振作並成為他的鐵粉新聞傳來善宰死亡的消息，小率卻神奇地回到高中發生意外前，那時她的雙腿不但行動自如，更遇上高中時期的善宰，她能改變過去，為兩人創造不一樣的未來嗎？

programme.title: 世上最漂亮的女兒
programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 355-諜影特攻
programme.desc: 當可怕的毀滅性武器落入跨國犯罪組織的手中，CIA探員梅絲決定找來各國的情報組織菁英，組成一支超越國界的間諜團隊355，試圖力挽狂瀾阻止第三次世界大戰發生

programme.title: 絕地戰警FOR LIFE
programme.desc: 來自邁阿密警局的黃金拍檔，在重現許多經典帥氣的動作場面之餘，也不忘維持自己一貫的搞笑風格！ 馬奎斯（馬汀勞倫斯 飾）已經是巡官，麥克威爾史密斯 飾卻步入中年危機，這回他們再次搭檔，為了新任務出馬！暌違17年系列電影重起上路，兩位大叔對上由凡妮莎哈金斯所率領的新世代警探的挑釁，新舊世代究竟會擦出什麼樣的動作火花？

programme.title: 奇蹟-給總統的一封信
programme.desc: 村裡的數學天才高中生俊慶今天向青瓦臺寄出第54封請願信，他的目標只有一個在村莊內建立車站但俊慶身為火車駕駛員的父親泰允，卻反對兒子的行為與想法，但為了姊姊寶京與村民們，俊慶仍不放棄這個夢想自稱女神的羅熙，被俊慶不凡的特質所吸引，為了幫助他實現目標而一同努力，究竟兩人是否能完成建立車站的夢想呢？

programme.title: 倫文敘老點柳先開
programme.desc: 倫文敘與柳先開同為才名遠播的風流才子，卻因性格南轅北轍，時常鬥嘴較勁鄉試後兩人皆入明校求學，不僅在課業上針鋒相對，更同時追求程情，鬧出不少笑話但當書院師長莫名被東廠帶走，兩人決定聯手偵破內情，也逐漸建立起友誼

programme.title: 侏羅紀世界-殞落國度
programme.desc: 延續侏羅紀世界劇情，努布拉島上的侏羅紀世界主題樂園被逃出牢籠的恐龍徹底摧毀，存活下來的各種恐龍在叢林中自生自滅 三年後，島上的休眠火山即將爆發，歐文（克里斯普拉特 飾）和克萊兒（布萊絲達拉斯霍華 飾）展開一項救援行動，率隊前往拯救島上的恐龍，避免恐龍再度滅絕，歐文一心一意想找到他從小養大的迅猛龍?小藍搶救恐龍之際，竟然發掘了一項天大的陰謀，很可能讓全地球陷入自從史前時期以來最可怕的危險處境，他們會如何化解？

programme.title: 一級玩家
programme.desc: 在瀕臨混亂與瓦解邊緣的2045年，人們為了逃避現實而進入虛擬世界綠洲OASIS中綠洲是由鬼才詹姆士哈勒代所創建，他宣布要把5千億的遺產留給第一個找到隱藏在綠洲中程式彩蛋的人，同時也可以掌控綠洲這個消息引發全球玩家的激烈競爭，因控制綠洲就等於控制了世界與未來 一位名不見經傳的少年韋德瓦茲泰謝里丹 飾，以黑馬之姿加入競爭，陷入了一場生死攸關的尋寶遊戲...

programme.title: 珍愛硬起來
programme.desc: 由珍妮佛勞倫斯飾演的麥蒂，為了保住她從小長大的房子，找到一則耐人尋味的徵人啟事一對有錢的恐龍家長，希望能在內向的兒子波西上大學前，找到人來與他約會出乎意料之外，麥蒂發現令人尷尬的波西，其實不是那麼簡單就能搞定的

programme.title: 人皮咒
programme.desc: 瑪雅（塔菈芭絲洛 飾）意外得知自己繼承了一間鄉下大宅，再回到位於偏遠鄉下的村落後，卻發現當地不但人煙稀少，且瀰漫著一股詭異氣氛然而，瑪雅不知道的是，村民多年來一直在尋找她的下落，希望殺死她來破除肆虐村落的恐怖詛咒瑪雅在奮力求生的同時，身世之謎也逐漸揭曉

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: 高中英文教師李淑敏努力教學，卻發現學生對她的課程始終興趣缺缺，反而熱衷到補習班上課，並視補教天王KK何為偶像李淑敏潛入補習班一探究竟，在課程中被KK發現，兩人大吵一架，竟激起KK對她的好感KK的出現，讓李淑敏改變對補習的看法，也開始用新的方式教學然而，一場意外讓他們都措手不及

programme.title: 血客聯盟

programme.title: 魅力四射-啦啦隊驚魂

programme.title: 地獄

programme.desc: 菩提老祖為了挽回自己的過失阻止兩人陰謀來到五嶽山，他說明至尊寶是孫悟空轉世，至尊寶不相信白骨精五百年前和孫悟空有一段糾纏不清的戀情，此時為了救至尊寶襲擊春三十娘，卻中毒受傷此時牛魔王殺到，二女不敵，挾持至尊寶和二當家逃回到盤絲洞春三十娘逼迫白晶晶殺掉至尊寶，卻反被二人關在機關春欲用迷情大法對付至尊寶，又錯用在二當家身上

programme.title: 鹿鼎記
programme.desc: 本片依據金庸名著拍攝而成，由張衛健演韋小寶，譚耀文飾演康熙，以清代康熙年間的社會歷史為背景，描寫了一個出身於社會最底層的少年韋小寶的傳奇經歷

programme.title: 警察故事三之超級警察
programme.desc: 講述成龍飾演的香港警察陳家駒與大陸公安合作調查走私集團的故事

programme.title: 頑皮炸彈
programme.desc: 少女安妮產下一子，卻被殺手追殺，嬰兒不慎落入垃圾車當中，最後被高山遊民救起六年後，有人以巨額獎金請徵信社找尋這名失蹤嬰兒，發現該嬰兒是高山部落的酋長阿依歐，但通知生父前來領回時，又遭槍手射擊

programme.title: 西遊記之仙履奇緣
programme.desc: 誰知至尊寶能拔出她手中的紫青寶劍，所以紫霞仙子則認定至尊寶才是她的情人，但此時月光寶盒卻不在紫（青）霞仙子手中，次日晚上，至尊寶回到旁觀觀音大士大戰孫悟空橋段，而月光寶盒則在其中，原來孫悟空是受不了唐僧太過碎碎唸，觀音菩薩後來也受不了唐三藏太過碎碎唸，而月光寶盒則在觀與孫兩人鬥法中甩來甩去，月光寶盒最後被至尊寶拿到手，卻陰錯陽差把唐三藏弄入另外一時空中，月光寶盒也隨之弄入另外一時空中

programme.title: 進行曲
programme.desc: 講述一群年輕男孩如何投入努力練習，讓他們所屬的樂旗聯隊可以闖入世界大賽為校爭光的熱血故事

programme.title: 新暫時停止呼吸
programme.desc: 靈幻道士英叔（林正英）的舊情人蓮妹，託其妹念英求援，師徒來到大帥府，見大帥身染屍毒，而身懷六甲的蓮，體中胎兒非常怪異，英發覺其褓姆並非常人，於是想引魔胎離開母體，加以消滅，但褓姆拼死護胎，英進退兩難之際，廣西殭屍群跟蹤而來，令眾人腹背受敵，一場殭屍魔胎的大戰就此展開...

programme.title: 上海皇帝之雄霸天下
programme.desc: 由於陸雲生極好面子，因此興辦銀行以接近上海文化界，彌補自己的文盲自卑感，更渴望當官漂白兼光耀門楣，遂暗中幫助國民政府做事以期謀得一官半職，先是協助打擊共產黨，後來又出錢出力幫政府對抗日本的侵略

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:321
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:321
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:328
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 素還真
programme.desc: 劇情描述少年素還真身懷絕藝，初入江湖原想見識廣大世界，卻因為新結識的好友寰宇堡少主禹歡，捲入了險惡的奪權紛爭，就連疼愛他的老師八趾麒麟，都因他遭難真相如霧，兇手卻在身邊？傳說力量現世，一場驚天對決即將開展一人三化的由來，未公開的白蓮秘辛且看素還真如何力挽狂瀾，阻止兇徒野心，如何仗劍而行，在江湖中走出自己的路，一個屬於霹靂的傳奇，即將誕生

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: 十九世紀中葉，舉世都在動盪變革中：歐洲德意志帝國成立；美國南北戰爭；日本明治維新；中國鴉片戰爭香港被割讓太平天國定都南京；風起雲湧，此起彼落時代的巨輪不會稍一止息，全世界在戰亂中走向現代，時勢造就了英雄的誕生，亦摧毀了人性的純真

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃
programme.desc: 故事講述第二次世界大戰納粹德軍於非洲沙漠隱藏了數百噸黃金，飛鷹Jackie與助手Ada德國少女Elsa及桃子一行人受命尋找他們千辛萬苦到達藏金地點，但這裏不只有黃金，還有一連串未解之謎等著他們

programme.title: 奇蹟-給總統的一封信
programme.desc: 故事敘述在一個只有鐵軌經過，卻無火車站的村莊裡，數學天才高中生俊慶不斷寄信給總統，他的目標只有一個：在村莊內建立車站但俊慶身為火車駕駛員的父親泰允，卻認為這根本是天方夜譚，反對兒子的行為與想法，但為了姊姊寶京與村民們，俊慶仍不放棄這個夢想自稱女神的羅熙為了幫助俊慶實現目標而一同努力，究竟兩人是否能完成建立車站的夢想呢？

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 因緣際會，玄奘無意間解開了五行山下鎮壓孫悟空的佛印孫悟空受制於觀音菩薩所賜的金箍，應下保護唐僧西去的使命悟空雖然心中不服玄奘，但他一路上開山問路，收服八戒沙僧，倒也盡忠職守然而，頭頂的金箍與唐僧制約他的緊箍咒法卻始終困擾著他白虎嶺白骨夫人千年成精，必須服用玄奘金身方可擺脫妖物輪回大限白骨精洞悉孫悟空與唐僧之間的隔閡，故而三番兩次挑撥二人師徒關係孫悟空在背負屈辱之下，還要以武鬥以智取難奈玄奘凡胎肉眼，看不清白骨真身白骨詭計得逞，師徒二人就此決裂

programme.title: 一眉道人

programme.title: 少男少女

programme.title: 宮:10

programme.title: 愛的麵包魂

programme.title: 佛跳牆
programme.desc: 李翰祥執導的佛跳牆共有四個單元，首個故事是描述一對母子因施予濟公一碗豆漿而逃過喪命之危；其二則說濟公幫助賣菜漢，逃離高利貸者的滋擾；其三則寫濟公以櫻桃化夜明珠，將大盜教訓一頓；最末一則是描寫濟公以巧計捉弄胡作非為的相爺父子李翰祥借濟公的善行，針貶權貴惡霸的種種惡行，為平民大眾吐一口烏氣

programme.desc: 呂熙一縷倩魂飄然入夢是旅程的起點，挾雜著半喪半喜的冥婚俚俗，為一償兒孫心願，全家總動員躲在路邊等待有緣人冥婚所用的紅包招來各式各樣的有緣人，有流浪漢有同性戀者有中年男子，竟然迎來金髮碧眼的阿斗仔！不經意撿到婚約的Leo，上一秒才決定用旅行療癒昨日戀情，卻又被逼著走入老婆是鬼魂的婚姻 這下子，比手劃腳誰也說不清，加上最難以化解的Culture Shock，簡直雞同鴨講！只好派出呂沛充當貼身翻譯，Leo勉為其難留下來，準備趁機落跑這趟旅程到底是不期而遇，還是冥冥中早已註定？

programme.title: 神鵰俠侶:33

programme.title: 新聞女王2:20

programme.desc: 多年前，楊碧芯因精神分裂險些毒殺兒子葉勁峰與女兒葉朗晴勁峰遭逢巨變解離出體弱但高智的人格朱璣，朱璣苦讀成筆跡專家，助身手不凡的勁峰執行臥底任務雙重炸彈案血字裸屍案促總督察江政勳集合勁峰精神科醫生韋睿傑拆彈警花游雁星法醫人類學家方菀芊組成特案組緝兇，竟譜出四人五角戀！

programme.title: 新聞女王2:22

programme.title: 黃金萬両:7
programme.desc: 萬家拉麵傳人萬帥（曹永廉飾）萬年（黃子恆飾）萬世（馬貫東飾）在一街上各自經營自家麵店，造成惡性競爭，龍九（麥美恩飾）霍小玉（朱智賢飾）及金枝（江嘉敏飾）妯娌之間也鬥氣不斷，身為一家之主的萬紫千紅（薛家燕飾）在先夫入夢後心生一計，在年三十帶回神秘木箱，?人推斷木箱內藏著皇上御賜的金大碗，對木箱虎視眈眈，千紅遂決定在新年年初一至七期間，遵行各種過年習俗和傳統，觀察各房表現來決定金大碗花落誰家

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Paper Plate
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with paper plates, just like Sketch in Boxtropolis, who makes paper plate mega monster masks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Obstacle Course Badge
programme.desc: Its time for the annual Animal Obstacle Course Race- the animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. Duggee has his Obstacle Course badge, together with the squirrels they form a team and the fun begins.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Going Slow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they come across Tortoise who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Map Readers
programme.desc: Glitch races the Go Jetters across the Academy to find the lost G.O. Dome of the Ancients.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Wolong Panda Reserve, China

programme.title: Nikhil Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Anniversary

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treat
programme.desc: Stanleys friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanleys vehicles.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Glitter Guide Piano Panic

When a string breaks on Marcus piano before his recital and he cant practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night

But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Sea Monsters Puff Fruit

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Chef Js Tale
programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that shes not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when theres no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the Whoopsies! Song.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Gloriasaurus
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Museum of Dinosaurs. But Gloria becomes obsessed with her handheld video game and misses out on whats in front of her, and ends up creating a disaster of colossal proportions.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Fang-Tastic Halloween
programme.desc: After hearing spooky rumors about the new habitat resident- A BAT- Marty is determined to protect his friends from the newcomer. But when the bat helps him out of a tough situation, Marty learns its better to get to know someone rather than judge them on false stereotypes.

programme.title: Archibalds Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Unpoppable Slumber Party Hard
programme.desc: Archibald accidentally ruins Beas plans by getting them both stuck in a giant unpoppable bubble. Archibald invites a friend to the Strutters slumber party whos kind of a downer. As the party goes south, Archibald helps his friend try new things to make it through the night.

programme.title: Archibalds Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Maximum Override Gators Giving
programme.desc: An overzealous librarian is after Archibald for an overdue library book. Archibald volunteers to be the host of Cousin Ashleys beloved family holiday. But when Ashleys favorite cousin threatens to bail, Archibald works extra hard to make this the best holiday ever.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Five

programme.desc: When Rocky and Bullwinkle want an interesting story to tell at their upcoming reunion, they accidentally take off for space in a very real rocket

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Return Of The Uncle King

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knights Fall Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knights Fall Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blades life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Caveheart Part II

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Hwam I Am
programme.desc: When the Croods find a man frozen in a block of ice, they thaw him and discover he was an old flame of Grans!

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Eep Cover
programme.desc: Determined for Grug and Guy to bond, Eep plans a hunt for the three of them. But when Eep sneakily makes it appear that Guy saved Grug from a charging bearacuda, the two believe Guy is a master hunter, and head to hunt a dangerous scorpulion.

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Dont Go Chasing Lavafalls

The team rallies behind this good news and launches one last attack to defeat Moray once and for all and stop the lava heading for the streets of Mexico City.

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - R.O.A.M. Around the World
programme.desc: With Ms. Nowhere and Palindrome off on a mission, the kids occupy their time playing the newest video game craze: Monster Manglers. But Tony isnt being a team player, which leads him solo into a mysterious race against an AI car. Is someone using this game as a trap for the Spy Racers?

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Rescue
programme.desc: Tonys been kidnapped..by Sudarikov! The rest of the team must break into the plane where Tonys being held and rescue him all while 30,000 feet in the air!

programme.title: 一站到底 少年季 第2季 Whos Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2

programme.title: Citra Timur : Guangdong
programme.desc: Dokumentari Citra Timur: Guangdong mengikuti wartawan Malaysia ke Guangdong, China yang sebuah wilayah yang berkembang daripada laluan perdagangan bersejarah menjadi pusat teknologi utama dunia. Menerusi kembara ini, penonton melihat sendiri bagaimana teknologi terkini dan budaya tradisional Lingnan hidup berdampingan. Di Guangzhou dan Shenzhen, wartawan meninjau industri dron dan kecerdasan buatan AI yang memacu bandar pintar, sektor pertanian, serta sistem logistik moden. Liputan diteruskan ke sektor automotif yang menyaksikan lonjakan teknologi Kenderaan Tenaga Baharu NEV dan pemanduan autonomi, lengkap dengan sesi pandu uji serta lawatan ke kilang pemasangan pintar. Selain kemajuan teknologi, kembara ini turut mengetengahkan pertukaran budaya dan gastronomi tempatan. Wartawan meneroka tradisi kulinari Guangdong seperti hidangan dim sum serta sajian Kantonis asli, di samping menyantuni seni ukiran Lingnan dan kawasan warisan bersejarah yang masih terpelihara. Dokumentari ini memberi gambaran jelas tentang keupayaan Guangdong memacu kemajuan masa depan sambil meraikan kekayaan tradisi makanan dan warisan budayanya.

programme.title: C-WAVE Global Music Co-Creation Plan: Joy Resonance of Nanyang Grand Finale
programme.desc: The Joy Resonance of Nanyang Grand Finale of the C-WAVE Global Music Co-Creation Plan is an APEC ChinaMalaysia people-to-people and cultural exchange activity. The 12 finalist entries will be performed live at the Grand Finale at the Kuala Lumpur Chinese Assembly Hall. The programme will showcase works from the Original Song, Adaptation and AI categories. Participants will compete for five support awards: C-WAVE Champion, Original Music Award, Cultural Fusion Award, Adaptation Award, and AI Music Award.Programme highlights: The finalists come from a range of countries and regions, including mainland China, Macao SAR, Malaysia, Indonesia, Canada and Portugal. Five judges from mainland China, Hong Kong SAR and Malaysia, among other places, will be invited to the event. The stage will feature multilingual musical works in Mandarin, Cantonese, Indonesian, English and other languages, spanning a variety of styles, including rock, RB, traditional Chinese-inspired music and pop.

programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk Jangan Bernafas. Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai footage menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. They even make the banker, HUNG LAW LOK LAUs business bankrupted and HUNGs daughter, PO, CHEUNG YUK SHAN has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN HSUAN JESSICA HESTERs female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent The First Tooth. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agents reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Gui Dui

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a persons subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the clubs top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Pass and Goal
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the childrens first.

programme.title: Call of Heroes
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: The movie consists of three tales about the horrors lurking in dark corners of the city. A young pop star goes back into depression when spooky things happen in her new home an online influencer performs live in a mall, but it ends up being a livestream of his death the residents of a tenement building battle a mysterious figure in the stairwell.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Changs first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: To afford a 200,000-yuan cochlear implant for her daughter, Gao takes a desperate risk that lands her in prison. During her time there, and after her release, she befriends three women. Despite their different personalities, they form a close bond to defy fate and support each other through hardship.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: An ordinary, cheerful and kind-hearted girl Bao, meets a troubled rich guy Edward by chance one summer. To ruin his fathers remarriage plans, Edward hires Bao and her friend to sabotage the wedding and that is how Bao and Edward meet and fall in love. All seems well for the sweet couple until their love quickly takes an unexpected turn

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: A massive fire caused by illegal garbage smuggling has triggered a radiation crisis in Hong Kong. Government advisor Simon joins the crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive to avert the disaster. A fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the cesium fallout. Facing the unprecedented catastrophe, can they save the city?

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from Fake Ghost Catchers Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhus sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lous brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says I do?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yus beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Yings father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt Shaolin Hand Lock from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Lings house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fishermans honour but accidentally kills the governors son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the rivers edge, he is rescued by the fishermans daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lins sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huangs father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his armys help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Village Of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlords beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yangs escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own Eight Diagram Pole Fight and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Panirendu
programme.desc: Anand, a journalist, uncovers a microfilm exposing an underworld gangs crimes. To retrieve it, the gangster sends a woman, leading to a thrilling clash of truth and deception.

programme.title: Gandeevadhari Arjuna
programme.desc: A special agent is tasked with safeguarding a top government official from potential threats at a global climate summit, facing danger and intrigue in a mission of extreme urgency.

programme.title: Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The film revolves around two rival gangster families vying for control of the city. Their ongoing feud forms the core conflict of the story.

programme.title: Ayodhi
programme.desc: During their trip to Rameswaram, a North Indian family faces numerous misfortunes until a stranger intervenes to assist them.

programme.title: Sindhubaadh
programme.desc: Thiru, a crook, falls in love with Venba and marries her before she goes to Malaysia. However, everything turns upside down when her father sells her for the skin trade.

programme.title: Vikram Vedha
programme.desc: Vikram, A Pragmatic Policeman, And His Partner Simon Are On The Hunt To Capture Vedha. When Vedha Voluntarily Surrenders, He Offers To Tell Vikram A Story, Throwing Vikrams Life Into Disarray.

programme.title: Vetrivel
programme.desc: Vetrivel and his friends kidnap a girl to help his brother unite with her, but their plan goes wrong, leading to messy and unexpected situations.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Love Insurance Kompany
programme.desc: A man who believes in old-school love meets Dheema, a woman embracing tech-driven romance. Their growing relationship challenges modern love norms and pits them against Suriyan, a powerful CEO of a lo

programme.title: Head Bush
programme.desc: In Bangalore, a political movement in the 70s gives rise to a dangerous underworld leader and causes tension among his group of friends.

programme.title: Patriot
programme.desc: Undercover agents uncover a vast surveillance conspiracy that grows into a national security crisis. They race to dismantle the network before it can suppress political opposition.

programme.title: Baby
programme.desc: Sakthi lives with her six-year-old daughter Adhithi after getting separated from her husband. Things become worse when Adhithi starts hearing voices and gets attached to a ghostly figure.

programme.desc: Sundaramoorthy, a timid lawyer, takes on the case of a man who sets himself on fire outside the court to protest his daughters abduction. Can Sundaramoorthy confront his fears and reveal the truth?

programme.desc: A Haunting Smell - Caspers Uncle Stinky has started to stink just that extra bit TOO much. Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinkys horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while hes going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now its CASPER whos the stinky one. Jimmy cant resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! - and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and its all Caspers fault! Hes got only hours before his Uncles return to rescue his friend from perpetual munchkin-sizedness AND return his Uncles manor as they left it!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School

This perfume is supposed to turn the one who wears it into the loveliest person in the worldbut actually it just makes OTHERS think youre great, whilst not actually changing the person its been sprayed on! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Caspers nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfumes spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! He takes his friends to this room and the three little monsters soon realize they are actually trapped in a terrible labyrinth! programme.title: 怒海情仇

programme.title: 来如风

programme.title: 十三太保

programme.title: 蝴蝶杯

programme.title: 鹰王

programme.title: 天使出更
programme.desc: 话说医务署发觉圣慕伦医院的医疗水准及设备大有问题，原来该院院长体弱多病，院务交陈医生主理；但陈个性主观，行事不依规章，连手下一班见习医生亦各具特性，时闹笑话，弄至院务混乱院长决定聘用资深护士长进行改革...

programme.title: 鬼马神偷

programme.title: 打雀英雄传

programme.title: 追女三十六房

programme.title: 怒袭
programme.desc: 前特种兵阿龙为调查记者女儿安心在跨境犯罪园区失踪一事，孤身深入这座由金钱与血腥统治的人间炼狱，揭开电信诈骗地下血库等黑暗内幕当发现女儿已卷入更大阴谋，暴怒的阿龙化身冷酷杀神，以铁血手段血战罪恶势力，誓要揪出幕后黑手

programme.title: 错爱迷踪
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小说家，两人一见钟情感情迅速升温原来女孩已悄然落入惊天迷局，全因小说家的前女友是个毁容的女鬼，她借用人面还魂复仇，与前男友联手开启夺命惊吓

programme.title: 鬼马飞人
programme.desc: 阿B为一名中学的体育教师，其执教之学校篮足球队成绩甚差，学校下令他务必赢得校际比赛冠军，否则将撤换教练阿B因头痛，误服同事研制之神药，变成超人，令球队屡次创造奇迹...

programme.title: 大内密探零零发
programme.desc: 零零发是宫廷四大高手之一，专职保卫皇帝的安全虽然不谙武功，却有着不寻常的嗜好：打造超越时代的发明皇上被掳后，他靠着自己的过人发明救驾

programme.title: 西游记第壹百零壹回之月光宝盒
programme.desc: 逍遥山贼斧头帮帮主至尊宝，意外得知自己是孙悟空的转世随着妖魔与仙界势力逼近，他被卷入月光宝盒引发的时空混乱之中在爱恨纠葛与不可违抗宿命之间，他必须在凡人身份与救世重任中作出抉择

programme.title: 赌城大亨II 之至尊无敌
programme.desc: 本片是赌城大亨之新哥传奇的续集，讲述贺新用了20年时间，成功建立其赌业王国，但同伴却不甘屈居其下，于是设局争夺赌业控制权另一方面，青年傅震为贺新旧情人的儿子，以为父亲被新所杀，便处心积虑安排报仇大计胆识过人的贺新面对各样的威胁，绝不坐以待弊

programme.title: 龙的传人
programme.desc: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

programme.title: 窥情
programme.desc: 波子一夜用望远镜窥看家邻近四周时，揭发了一宗命案但经警方调查村内居民，包括富商情妇Rita邮差纸店主老王及其妻子等人，揭开彼此间错综复杂的情欲关系之同时，还是不知谁是受害人，谁是凶手 于是，波子决定用自己的方法继续调查

programme.title: 混世四猴：神猴归来
programme.desc: 救世主灵明石猴曾赐予绝望女孩生存的希望，并许下守护终生的承诺不料多年后，他与傲慢的三眼战神展开一场毁天灭地的大战，最终惨遭击败，金身碎裂堕入凡尘失去神力的石猴，究竟能否重燃斗志，打破命运枷锁，再度归来履行当年对女孩许下的誓言？

programme.title: 风流冤鬼
programme.desc: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下钜款明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

programme.title: 僵尸先生
programme.desc: 茅山师父九叔受委托为富翁起棺迁葬，祈求新墓地能催财惟富翁之尸体出现尸变后，变成僵尸，并在村内四处为害此时，九叔的两名徒弟亦分别被僵尸所伤和受女鬼迷惑九叔如何同时面对徒弟们生死存亡，以及僵尸为害的问题呢？

programme.title: 倒数回击
programme.desc: 天才拳击手徐佳阳为了替父亲还赌债在地下酒馆打黑拳时被举报，痛失奥运资格赛，陨落拳坛十年后，铁血教练陈丽月决要助她实现父亲的遗愿，重回拳坛找回昔日的自己当拳击的热血碰上责任时，曾经失落的拳击梦能否再度燃烧？

programme.title: 白蛇传说
programme.desc: 这部奇幻动作片改编自中国经典传说白蛇传，讲述郎中许仙爱上化身为女子的千年白蛇白蛇的真实身份被揭露后，高僧法海为守护人类与超自然力量之间的平衡，不得不挺身而出，展开一场惊心动魄的对决

programme.title: 黑白潜行
programme.desc: 警校生阿山奉命卧底监狱，接近犯罪集团二把手阿天，暗中搜集其犯罪证据阿天出狱后，阿山协助他以铁血手段一路厮杀，最终登上社团话事人之位然而，阿山频繁与警方接触的行迹逐渐败露，卧底身份被社团识破，瞬间陷入生死危局，而一个足以颠覆一切的秘密也即将浮出水面

programme.title: 替身纸人
programme.desc: 警方在调查一宗团伙杀人案时，突然又发生了离奇的纸人杀人事件，嫌疑人一个接一个被杀随着不断挖出的线索，警方最终发现这背后隐藏着横跨两代人的秘密与悲剧

programme.title: 神勇双妹唛
programme.desc: 故事描述一对表姐妹梁山伯与祝英台乃斗气冤家，两女为争夺神秘俊男阿山欢心，却惹来大圈杀手威吓逼害，更陷入一场宝物争夺战两女身陷险境，惟有摒弃前嫌，联手反抗

programme.title: 醉拳
programme.desc: 年轻气盛的黄飞鸿因招惹地方恶霸之子，被父亲送去跟随醉拳大师苏乞儿受训一年当父亲揭发恶霸欲将国有矿产卖给日本人的阴谋后，顿成刺杀目标为救父并阻止交易，飞鸿施展自创的醉拳，击败众杀手

programme.title: 惊心妒怨
programme.desc: 艳丽女模余虹敏在一间盛传闹鬼的废弃医院中离奇身亡事后，她生前的摄影师不断接到如怨灵索命般的诡异来电，合作撰稿人突遭严重车祸，而她的挚友亦突然离奇失踪一连串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而来，彷佛死者充满妒恨的怨魂，正在黑暗中展开疯狂报复

programme.title: 百变星君
programme.desc: 富家子李泽星挂名留学，实际上却挥金如土，并自命情圣，称霸校园一日，因搭上黑帮老大情妇Silvia，而遭黑帮刺杀，被炸得粉身碎骨这个财大气粗的李泽星以百变金刚之姿态复活，还掌握了独特的能力，得到一份真正的工作，还有他真心爱上的意中人

programme.title: 无间道
programme.desc: 陈永仁被员警训练学校强逼退学后，被渗进三合会的卧底工作刘健明是三合会会员，18岁时被安排加入香港员警，作为黑社会卧底陈永仁及刘健明各自渐露头角，但却同时在这无间道的旅程中接受严峻的考验警方及三合会得悉双方均有卧底潜伏，随即展开连串的互相追遂

programme.title: 三十处男
programme.desc: 设计师赵宇庭被批算三十岁前结婚，会被妻子克死，赵父遂严禁赵宇庭结交异性但限期将届，他急不及待觅对象荔玲与母亲同为死人化妆师，为了交男友改为新娘化妆，此时她认识了赵宇庭...

programme.title: 油鬼子
programme.desc: 故事描述沈元（李修贤）亡父与林亚峇（谷峰）为生死之交沈父临终前，曾在林之背上刺有神秘图案，而此图实是一道有特殊功能的符后林为保护女儿中月（陈萍）而杀人，被判死刑；林被处死前，着沈把图案描下，以备不时之须沈按图文指示，化身成威力无穷的油鬼子，帮助过不少人，亦铲除不少坏人，但最终却陷入疯狂状态

programme.title: 承欢记 第24集

programme.title: 长月烬明 第3集

programme.title: 金宵大厦2 第19集

programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第1集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第9集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第11集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第9集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第9集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第10集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第14集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第2集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
programme.desc: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Padraic and Colm find themselves at an impasse when Colm abruptly ends their lifelong friendship. An upset Padraic refuses to accept the situation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid 1984
programme.desc: Under the guidance of a master of the martial arts, a teenage boy develops the faith and self-confidence to overcome tremendous odds.

programme.title: The Producers
programme.desc: A conniving Broadway producer and his meek accountant devise a scheme where they charm wealthy old ladies into investing in a theatre show - and then put on a sure-fire disaster, so nobody will ask for their money back.

programme.title: The Elephant Man
programme.desc: With a facial difference due to a rare disease, John Merrick is abused and ostracised, living his life as the Elephant Man in a circus sideshow. However, Dr Treves sees the person beyond the deformities.

programme.title: The Deer Hunter
programme.desc: The lives of three small-town steel mill workers are changed forever after fighting in the Vietnam War, the experience leaving them with terrible physical and psychological wounds.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen is fired and rushes out to catch a train home, her life splits into two parallel realities. In one world, she catches the train in the other, she misses it - one split second leads her on two different journeys of the heart.

programme.title: Three Days of the Condor
programme.desc: When a CIA intelligence officer finds all his co-workers dead, he must outwit those responsible and figure out who he can really trust.

programme.title: The Power of One
programme.desc: Through his boxing prowess, an English boy living in South Africa becomes a symbol of hope during a time of war.

programme.title: One From the Heart
programme.desc: On the anniversary of their five-year romance, Hank and Frannie decide to go their separate ways. Over one night in Las Vegas, they each seek comfort elsewhere. Featuring songs by Tom Waits and Crystal Gale.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Detective Rixley relentlessly pursues a gang of outlaws led by Jesse James and Cole Younger.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Trying to decide what to do with his life, college graduate Benjamin finds an unexpected diversion when he is seduced by an older woman, Mrs. Robinson, and then starts to fall in love with her daughter.

programme.title: Clockwise
programme.desc: Headmaster Brian Stimpson is fanatical about being on time. But when he boards the wrong train on his way to a conference he finds himself in a nightmarish journey of misunderstandings, ex-girlfriends, unruly Sixth Formers and even the police.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: Four teenagers must prove their mettle as they begin their journey at the New York High School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Arizona Dream

programme.title: The Godfather

programme.title: The Man Who Fell to Earth

programme.desc: 전문가와 함께 쉽고 유쾌하게 배우는 부모 맞춤 성교육 안내서!

programme.title: 최고의 요리비결
programme.desc: 당신도 요리의 달인이 될 수 있다. 최고의 요리비결은 국내 최고의 요리전문가에게서 최고의 요리 비결만을 전수받을 수 있는 정통 요리 프로그램!

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 마샤와 곰

programme.title: 왔다! 내 손주
programme.desc: 해외에 거주하고 있어 자주 보지 못하는 손자, 손녀들과 할머니, 할아버지가 만나 보내는 며칠의 시간. 뭉클한 감동이 깃든 만남부터 그들에게 주어진 짧은 기간 일어나는 일들 속에 따듯한 가족애를 담아내는 프로그램

programme.title: 세계테마기행

programme.title: EBS 다큐프라임

programme.title: 몸이 답이다 스페셜

programme.title: 친절한 진료실 스페셜
programme.desc: 전문성은 기본, 환자 눈높이용 친절한 설명과 유머로 어려운 건강 정보도 쉽게 술술 당신의 건강 궁금증, lt친절한 진료실gt에서 밀착 진료해 드립니다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리

programme.title: Wolastoqey Petroglyphs to Pixels
programme.desc: Wolastoqey These brothers are exceptional figures in northwest coast art, excelling as carvers, designers, singers and dancers, making a powerful impact in their genre.

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker
programme.desc: Mikmaq Shawn visits Bear River First Nation where he harvests sweetgrass and learns some new Mikmaq words while painting. A mother sends a message of hope and forgiveness to her adult children and the story of an unknown sibling is revealed.

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker
programme.desc: Mikmaq Shawn takes a water taxi to Opitsaht, the ancestral territory of the Tla-o-qui-aht, to connect with Tribal Parks Guardian Saya Masso and learn about the Big Sky Trail.

programme.title: Inuktitut Nunavummi Mamarijavut
programme.desc: Inuktitut, South Baffin Zipporah Ungalaq is joined by guest Nate Jewett who shows her how to stew and can polar bear meat in a way that keeps it tender and delicious.

programme.title: Innu-aimun Chuck and the First Peoples Kitchen
programme.desc: Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit In Kangiqsujuaq, Chuck joins Noah Annahatak, one of Nunaviks top hunters. They go by boat to a great location and shoot a caribou near the shore. They field dress the animal on site and return to the village.

programme.title: Innu-aimun De Pessamit Sheshatshiu
programme.desc: Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit Instrument banni par les missionnaires europens ds leur arrive, le tambour a persist travers les sicles. Aujourdhui, devant lorchestre symphonique de Montral, lan Api Bellefleur le met lhonneur en.

programme.title: Cree Red Earth Uncovered
programme.desc: Cree, Plains Tom tells Shayla to go to Vancouver Island to learn about an elusive sea serpent, known as the Cadborosaurus, aka Caddy.

programme.title: Cree Wild Rose Vets
programme.desc: Cree, Plains Dr. Cori sees it all, from stray puppies and anxious dogs with persistent paw injuries, to horses needing dental work. Dr. Allison tackles a growing lump on cuddly Jorah and takes an x-ray that means bad news for an older dog.

programme.title: Michif Amplify
programme.desc: Michif, FrenchHaida and Cree singer Kristi Lane Sinclair shares her emotional journey of returning to Haida Gwaii to find love and forgiveness. In this episode dedicated to Kristis late mother, Kristi connects with close friend and fellow creator.

programme.title: Michif Nation Untamed
programme.desc: Michif, Heritage Sam and Chuck journey to the boreal forest of northern Saskatchewan to experience traditional dogsledding and snowshoeing. They discover how a remote camp uses land-based learning initiatives to help keep Cree culture and language.

programme.title: Salish Warrior Games
programme.desc: Salish Host Steve Sxwithultxw learns some of the games the Dene Nation has developed to test skills and stay in shape. During the Dene Games, members participate in sports like dog mushing and snow snake, as well as games like finger pull, stick.

programme.title: Nsyilxcen Quest Out West Wild Food
programme.desc: NsyilxcenTracey visits the Lower Nicola Indian Band and speaks with Chief Stuart Jackson about the devastation caused by recent climatic events.Tracey then meets Lorna Shuter,operator of Shulus Gardens, and cooks a meal with the band schools chef.

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第1集
programme.desc: 誰是兇手講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.desc: 感動全世界觀眾的聲光伴我飛全新數碼復修經典重映!由星光伴我心導演基斯比湯納度執導在不同人生階段觀看, 都有不一樣的體悟!維珍尼亞號郵輪上, 一名棄嬰被發現在鋼琴之上, 沒名沒姓, 無父無母, 結果船員取名為他出生的年份 - 1900這位一生不曾踏上陸地的天才鋼琴師, 觸動了郵輪上的每顆心靈, 每個聽過他演奏的人, 都會被深深打動, 還包括那位充當過客的她......金球獎最佳原創配樂得主

programme.title: 七夜冤靈

programme.desc: 地獄三使者河正宇朱智勛金香起 飾 引渡千年最後一個貴人金秀鴻金東旭 飾展開七七四十九天審判, 準備四人一起投胎轉世之際, 鎮守家宅的家神成造神馬東石 飾為搶救爺爺亡魂, 不惜挑戰一切規則, 翻轉陽間, 觸怒了閻羅王李政宰 飾地獄三使者為了重整陽間秩序, 一方面帶領秀鴻繼續地獄審判；另一方面於陽間與成造神正面交鋒! 陰間與陽間翻天覆地, 意外驚醒了所有人的前世記憶!因果迴旋之下, 各大神祇將在49日狹路重逢, 迎戰終極審判...

programme.title: 女黑俠黃鶯
programme.desc: 黃鶯欲助義父葉利欽鏟除幫令壞份子雷豹, 卻反被雷豹先發制人, 義父及義妹喜鵲被鎗殺, 自己則頭部受撞擊而失憶, 被神婆及阿貞所救二人以為黃鶯為千金小姐, 遂悉心照顧她, 希望獲得報答阿貞與車房工人阿吉相戀, 為母反對, 其母則因豪賭而欠下巨債, 阿貞逼得與黃鶯到夜總會當舞女還債阿吉與雷豹重遇, 原來他是洗心革面的黑社會人物, 雷豹欲除之以安心葉之幫令父老邀阿吉替葉報仇黃鶯在一次打鬥中恢復記憶, 決找雷豹報仇她聯同阿吉和喜鵲之孿生妹妹把雷豹殺掉, 為義父, 喜鵲報得大仇

programme.title: 懲毖錄 第26集

programme.title: 印度大工廠 第1季第10集
programme.desc: 普通人的一生總共有三年是在馬桶上度過, 這麼重要的生活物品是怎麼製造的呢?人們穿不膩的時尚單品就是牛仔褲, 配什麼上衣都適合, 原本是工廠工人在穿的耐用褲子, 如今成為每個人衣櫃裡的必備單品帶你來看印度工廠生產牛仔褲的流程輪胎一詞的英文語源是衣服, 因為輪胎被視為是鋁圈的外衣汽車想要上路不可或缺的零件, 你可知道是怎麼做出來的嗎?本節目帶你來一窺究竟

programme.title: 求生1加1 第5季第4集 -墜落荒島
programme.desc: 在本集中, 喬與麥特遇到的假設情境是: 兩名機師駕駛的飛機墜落在百慕達三角洲的某座小島上, 但兩人於過程中失散現在他們必須設法找到對方, 並利用飛機上的可用物資求生, 尋找可以喝的淡水, 以及設法求援喬以滅火器和機上找到的導管做了一個簡陋的海水淡化器, 但沒有火的話就無法使用而麥特不斷嘗試製作生火工具, 卻屢屢失敗, 兩人陷入危機

programme.title: 野性無窮盡 第1季第2集 -短命

programme.title: 科技長征 第1季第6集 -動物的思考力

programme.title: 舊車改造突擊隊 第7季第7集 -Lannys 67 Ford Fairlane GTA
